bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; get_count(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; code=80; a=$(get_count "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='room' AND board_key='area_bbs' AND chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=116 AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 91; test "$a" = 1 || code=$((code+1)); b=$(get_count "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='room' AND board_key='video_chat' AND chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1605 AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 92; test "$b" = 1 || code=$((code+2)); c=$(get_count "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='room' AND board_key='gay_board' AND chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=4 AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 93; test "$c" = 1 || code=$((code+4)); d=$(get_count "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement' AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL") || exit 94; test "$d" -ge 1 || code=$((code+8)); exit "$code"
